CustomField.description:
Formula Checkbox field created to capture "Options 1 or 3" from the Edafio data migration. Identifies if server/backup device selected is either option 1 or 3. Used for showing data in Conga merge templates.
JIRA Ticket: AEOM-63
CustomField.formula: OR( ISPICKVAL( ServerDeviceBackup__c , 'Opt 1 - Client Svr, Tierpoint'), ISPICKVAL( ServerDeviceBackup__c , 'Opt 3 - Edafio Svr, Tierpoint') )
CustomField.label: Options 1 or 3
